clips.meaning: Gentle breathing, friendly head tilt and a relaxed tail sway.
Turns its head to inspect both sides, with a curious tilt and tail response.
Three broad paired wing flaps while standing; no flight or physical lift is claimed.
Bows, lifts its head, spreads its wings and wags its tail in a happy flourish; feet stay planted.
